const OH_METER:u32 = 4096u32;

record OhType { syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax; next:*OhType; }
record OhState {
    failure:u32;
    failures:usize;
    error_offset:usize;
    types:*OhType;
    type_calls:usize;
    binding_calls:usize;
    name_calls:usize;
    group_calls:usize;
    call_calls:usize;
    statement_calls:usize;
    contract_calls:usize;
}

fn oh_length(text:*u8)->usize {
    var count:usize = 0usize;
    while text[count] != 0u8 { count = count + 1usize; }
    return count;
}

fn oh_equal(a:*u8, b:*u8)->bool {
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while a[index] == b[index] {
        if a[index] == 0u8 { return true; }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    return false;
}

fn oh_error(state:*OhState, stage:*OvStage, location:*RmdLoc, kind:u32)->bool {
    if (*state).failure != kind { return false; }
    (*state).failures = (*state).failures + 1usize;
    (*state).error_offset = (*location).offset;
    rmd_set_error((*stage).context, (*location).source, (*location).offset,
        "external overload hook failed");
    return true;
}

fn oh_read_type(reader:*RmdReader, user:*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    if !rr_is_name(reader, "meter") { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    var offset:usize = (*reader).token.offset;
    rr_next(reader);
    var syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax = rr_new_type(reader, OH_METER, offset);
    var base:*RmdTypeSyntax = rr_type(reader);
    var link:*OhType = rr_alloc(reader, sizeof(OhType), alignof(OhType)) as *OhType;
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    (*syntax).base = base;
    var state:*OhState = user as *OhState;
    *link = make OhType { syntax:syntax, next:(*state).types };
    (*state).types = link;
    return syntax;
}

fn oh_type_key(stage:*OvStage, syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax, buffer:*OvText,
               depth:usize, user:*u8)->bool {
    if (*syntax).kind != OH_METER { return false; }
    var state:*OhState = user as *OhState;
    (*state).type_calls = (*state).type_calls + 1usize;
    if oh_error(state, stage, &(*syntax).loc, 1u32) { return true; }
    ov_encode_type(stage, (*syntax).base, buffer, depth + 1usize);
    return true;
}

fn oh_binding(stage:*OvStage, syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax, user:*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    var state:*OhState = user as *OhState;
    (*state).binding_calls = (*state).binding_calls + 1usize;
    oh_error(state, stage, &(*syntax).loc, 2u32);
    return syntax;
}

fn oh_expression(walk:*OvWalk, expression:*RmdExpr,
                  expected:*RmdTypeSyntax, user:*u8)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    var state:*OhState = user as *OhState;
    if (*expression).kind == RMD_E_NAME && (oh_equal((*(*expression).name).text, "choose") ||
       oh_equal((*(*expression).name).text, "zero")) {
        (*state).name_calls = (*state).name_calls + 1usize;
    }
    if (*expression).kind == RMD_E_GROUP { (*state).group_calls = (*state).group_calls + 1usize; }
    if (*expression).kind == RMD_E_CALL { (*state).call_calls = (*state).call_calls + 1usize; }
    oh_error(state, (*walk).stage, &(*expression).loc, 3u32);
    return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
}

fn oh_statement(walk:*OvWalk, statement:*RmdStmt, user:*u8)->bool {
    var state:*OhState = user as *OhState;
    (*state).statement_calls = (*state).statement_calls + 1usize;
    oh_error(state, (*walk).stage, &(*statement).loc, 4u32);
    return false;
}

fn oh_contract(stage:*OvStage, declaration:*RmdDecl, user:*u8)->*RmdName {
    var state:*OhState = user as *OhState;
    (*state).contract_calls = (*state).contract_calls + 1usize;
    var name:*RmdName = ov_intern(stage, "meter_safe", 10usize);
    oh_error(state, stage, &(*declaration).loc, 5u32);
    return name;
}

fn oh_test(failure:u32)->bool {
    var context:RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&context, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var state:OhState = make OhState {
        failure:failure, failures:0usize, error_offset:0usize, types:null(*OhType),
        type_calls:0usize, binding_calls:0usize, name_calls:0usize, group_calls:0usize,
        call_calls:0usize, statement_calls:0usize, contract_calls:0usize
    };
    var source:RmdSource = make RmdSource {
        path:"overload-hook-input", identity:1u64, size:0usize,
        bytes:"fn choose(value:meter u32)->u32{return 41u32;}\nfn choose(value:u32)->u32{return 42u32;}\nfn metered(value:meter u32)->u32{return (choose)(value);}\nfn plain(value:u32)->u32{return choose(value);}\nfn zero()->unit{}\nfn invoke()->unit{zero();}"
    };
    source.size = oh_length(source.bytes);
    var reader_hooks:RmdReaderHooks = make RmdReaderHooks {
        user:&state as *u8, declaration:null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdDecl),
        statement:null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdStmt),
        prefix:null(fn(*RmdReader,*u8)->*RmdExpr), type_syntax:oh_read_type
    };
    var parsed:*RmdUnit = rr_read(&context, &source, 0usize, source.size, &reader_hooks);
    var hooks:OvHooks = make OvHooks {
        user:&state as *u8, type_key:oh_type_key, binding_type:oh_binding,
        expression:oh_expression, statement:oh_statement, contract:oh_contract
    };
    var stage:OvStage = uninit;
    ov_init(&stage, &context, "meter_fixture_v1", &hooks);
    var success:bool = parsed != null(*RmdUnit) && ov_prepare(&stage);
    var valid:bool = context.failure == null(*u8);
    if failure != 0u32 {
        valid = valid && !success && stage.failed && state.failures == 1usize &&
            context.error_count == 1usize && context.error_loc.source == &source &&
            context.error_loc.offset == state.error_offset &&
            oh_equal(&context.error[0usize], "external overload hook failed");
    } else {
        valid = valid && success && !stage.failed && context.error_count == 0usize &&
            state.type_calls != 0usize && state.binding_calls != 0usize &&
            state.statement_calls != 0usize && state.contract_calls == 6usize &&
            state.name_calls == 3usize && state.group_calls == 1usize && state.call_calls == 3usize;
        if valid {
            var special:*RmdDecl = (*parsed).declarations;
            var ordinary:*RmdDecl = (*special).next;
            var metered:*RmdDecl = (*ordinary).next;
            var plain:*RmdDecl = (*metered).next;
            var metered_name:*RmdExpr = (*(*(*(*metered).body).body).expr).left;
            var plain_name:*RmdExpr = (*(*(*(*plain).body).body).expr).left;
            valid = (*(*metered_name).left).name == (*special).name &&
                (*plain_name).name == (*ordinary).name && (*special).name != (*ordinary).name;
            var type_link:*OhType = state.types;
            while type_link != null(*OhType) {
                *(*type_link).syntax = *(*(*type_link).syntax).base;
                type_link = (*type_link).next;
            }
            valid = valid && rmd_collect(&context) && rmd_resolve(&context) && rmd_check(&context);
        }
    }
    if !valid {
        var message:*u8 = "overload hook contract failed in mode ";
        var digit:u8 = (failure as u8) + 48u8;
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, message, oh_length(message));
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, &digit, 1usize);
        rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "\n", 1usize);
        if context.error_count != 0usize {
            rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, &context.error[0usize], oh_length(&context.error[0usize]));
            rmd0_host_write_stream(2u32, "\n", 1usize);
        }
    }
    rmd_context_destroy(&context);
    return valid;
}

fn main(argc:i32, argv:**u8)->i32 {
    var kind:u32 = 0u32;
    while kind <= 5u32 {
        if !oh_test(kind) { return 1i32; }
        kind = kind + 1u32;
    }
    return 0i32;
}
